title: IREMEMBERTHISPLACE.jar
description: A horror modpack that adds a bunch of scary dimensions ( like wonderland.jar)
body:
"The world glitches. The forest breathes. And somewhere… a script broke long before you joined."
This modpack is a reality compiler error. It combines standard optimization and utility mods with corrupted, unstable, and metafictional horror elements.

You will recognize the biomes. You will recognize the blocks. But the rules? The rules are rewritten every time you launch.

📦 What's inside:
🧠 The Core
FerriteCore – memory optimization (so you forget less)

Entity Culling – stops rendering what you don't see (but what sees you?)

Geckolib – smooth animations for things that shouldn't move

🗺️ Navigation & Utility
Xaeros Minimap – shows the world. sometimes shows extra dots.

wood.jar – basic wood logic. mostly intact. mostly.

🌑 The Horrors (Unstable Reality)
The Broken Script – breaks random game rules. intentionally.

no_moon.jar – no moonlight. no safety. no escape.

Evil Hunter – something hunts you. not a mob. a presence.

wonderland.jar – biomes fold into impossible geometries

000.jar – writes errors into your save files. permanently.

👁️ Memory & Identity
we were never real.jar – blocks disappear when you look away

Gonebutnotforgotten.jar 2.0 – deleted entities return. older. angrier.

Event.jar remake – event system corrupted. expect the unexpected.

Elysium.jar – heaven is a loading screen that never finishes

⚠️ Important Notes:
This modpack is fully playable. All mods are functional.

Performance is stable (thanks to FerriteCore & Entity Culling).

The horror is not loud. It's quiet. It's in the missing moon. In the map markers you didn't place. In the log file that writes itself.

If you remember this place…
Leave before the script breaks completely.
If you don't remember…
Good. That means it's working.

🧩 Dependencies & Loader:
Loader: Fabric (recommended) or Quilt

Minecraft Version: 1.20.1 (tested)

Required: None – standalone pack

⚠️Warning⚠️ - The modpack can crash your game

Multiplayer is not working in this modpack

Reccomended to play with Golden Days Base https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/golden-days
